title: CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

paragraphs.en: Anne was reprimanded by Marilla on the following Friday after returning from Mrs. Lynde's house. Marilla accused her of wearing an overly decorated hat with flowers at church.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在星期五从雷切尔·林德太太家回来后，被玛丽拉训斥了一顿。玛丽拉指责她在教堂戴了一顶装饰过于繁复的花帽子。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, Mrs. Rachel said your hat looked ridiculous with roses and buttercups," Marilla began sternly. "Why did you do such a thing?"
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，雷切尔太太说你的帽子戴上玫瑰和金盏花显得很滑稽，”玛丽拉严肃地说，“你为什么要这样做？”

paragraphs.en: "I thought the flowers would look nice on my hat," Anne protested weakly. "Many girls had bouquets pinned to their dresses."
paragraphs.zh: “我觉得这些花戴在帽子上会很好看，”安妮有气无力地抗议道，“很多女孩都会把花别在衣服上呢。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla was unyielding. "It's silly to put any flowers on your hat, no matter the color. You're being aggravating!"
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉坚持己见：“无论什么颜色的花都别往帽子上插，那真是太傻了。你这是故意惹人烦！”

paragraphs.en: Anne felt guilty and apologetic. "I'm sorry, Marilla. I didn't think you'd mind.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮感到内疚并道歉道：“对不起，玛丽拉。我没有想到你会介意。”

paragraphs.en: The flowers were so pretty, but maybe I should have thought more about it."
paragraphs.zh: 这些花虽然漂亮，但或许我当时应该多考虑一下。

paragraphs.en: Marilla softened slightly. "Don't cry anymore. Mrs. Rachel said people talked about it a lot when they saw you.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉稍微缓和了一下语气：“别哭了。雷切尔太太说过，人们见到你的时候经常会议论这件事。”

paragraphs.en: She couldn't tell you to take them off in time. Diana Barry is home today. We're going to borrow a skirt pattern from her, and you can meet Diana."
paragraphs.zh: 她没法让你及时脱下它们。今天戴安娜·巴里回家了。我们要去她那儿借一条裙子的裁剪图样，你也可以见见戴安娜。

paragraphs.en: Anne stood up, hands clasped, tears still shining on her cheeks. The hemmed dish towel slipped to the floor unnoticed.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮站起身来，双手紧握，泪水还在她脸颊上闪烁。那块缝了边的餐巾滑落到地上，却未引起她的注意。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Marilla, I'm frightened—now that it has come, I’m actually scared. What if she doesn’t like me! It would be the most tragic disappointment of my life."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，玛丽拉，我现在害怕了——事情真的发生了，我竟然感到害怕。如果她不喜欢我该怎么办！那将会是我一生中最悲惨的失望。”

paragraphs.en: "Now, don't get flustered," Marilla said gently. "And stop using such long words. They sound funny in a little girl.
paragraphs.zh: “别紧张兮兮的，”玛丽拉温柔地说，“还有，别用这么长的单词。在小女孩嘴里说出来可不好听呢。”

paragraphs.en: Diana will probably like you. But it’s her mother you need to impress. If Mrs. Barry doesn’t approve, nothing else matters.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜可能会喜欢你，但你需要给她的母亲留下好印象。如果巴里太太不认可你，其他一切都无关紧要。

paragraphs.en: She might think poorly of you if she heard about your outburst and going to church with buttercups."
paragraphs.zh: 她要是听说你那次爆发还去教堂带了金盏花，可能会对你印象不佳。

paragraphs.en: Anne was trembling; her face pale and tense.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮浑身颤抖，面色苍白而紧张。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Marilla, you'd be excited too," Anne said as she hurried to put on her hat. "If you were meeting a little girl who could be your bosom friend, whose mother might not like you."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，玛丽拉，你也会激动不已的，”安妮一边匆忙戴帽子一边说，“如果你遇到一个可以成为你知心朋友的小女孩，而她的妈妈可能并不喜欢你的话。”

paragraphs.en: They took the short path across the brook and up the firry hill grove to Orchard Slope. Mrs. Barry answered Marilla's knock. A tall woman with black eyes and hair, she had a resolute mouth.
paragraphs.zh: 他们穿过小溪，沿着fir树成林的小山坡向上走，最终抵达了果园坡。巴里太太应答了玛丽拉的敲门声。她个子高挑，黑眼睛黑头发，嘴边带着坚定的表情。

paragraphs.en: "How do you do, Marilla?" she said warmly. "Come in.
paragraphs.zh: “玛丽拉，你好吗？”她热情地说，“请进。”

paragraphs.en: This is the little girl you’ve adopted, I suppose?"
paragraphs.zh: 这就是你收养的那小女孩吧？

paragraphs.en: "Yes, this is Anne Shirley," Marilla replied.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，这就是安妮·谢里夫。”玛丽拉回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Spelled with an E," Anne added, determined to clarify that point despite her tremors.
paragraphs.zh: “拼写时带个E，”安妮补充道，尽管内心震颤，她还是决心澄清这一点。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Barry shook hands and asked kindly, "How are you?"
paragraphs.zh: 巴里太太伸出手与她握手，亲切地问道：“你最近怎么样？”

paragraphs.en: "I am well in body although considerably rumpled up in spirit, thank you ma'am," Anne said gravely. Then she whispered to Marilla, "Was there anything startling in that, Marilla?"
paragraphs.zh: “我身体状况不错，尽管精神上有些乱糟糟的，谢谢您，太太。”安妮庄重地说。然后她小声对玛丽拉问道：“马里拉，刚才那件事有没有什么出乎意料的地方？”

paragraphs.en: Diana sat on the sofa, reading a book which she dropped when they entered. A pretty little girl with her mother's black eyes and hair, rosy cheeks, and a merry expression from her father.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜坐在沙发上读书，他们进来时她手中的书掉了。这位母亲有着黑色的眼睛和头发、红润的脸颊的小女孩，继承了父亲那欢快的表情。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Barry introduced her daughter Diana to Marilla and Anne. She suggested Anne take Diana outside to show her the flowers, noting that reading too much was not good for Diana's eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里太太把女儿戴安娜介绍给玛丽拉和安妮。她建议安妮带戴安娜出去看看花，顺便说了一句，戴安娜看书太多对眼睛不太好。

paragraphs.en: In the garden, bathed in soft sunset light, Anne and Diana stood shyly facing each other among a cluster of tiger lilies.
paragraphs.zh: 在柔和的夕阳余晖中，安妮和戴安娜站在一簇虎斑百合花前，羞涩地相对而立。

paragraphs.en: The Barry garden was filled with various flowers, including bleeding hearts, peonies, narcissi, roses, and columbines. Despite its destiny-laden nature, it delighted Anne's heart.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里花园里栽种着各种鲜花，包括心碎花、牡丹、水仙、玫瑰和翠雀花。尽管这片花园似乎承载着某种命运的意味，但它却让安妮的心灵感到愉悦。

paragraphs.en: Anne asked Diana if she could be her bosom friend. Diana laughed but agreed that they would make good playmates since there were no other girls nearby.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮问戴安娜是否能成为她的知心朋友。戴安娜笑了笑，但还是同意她们可以做个不错的玩伴，因为附近没有其他女孩。

paragraphs.en: Eagerly, Anne asked Diana to swear to be her friend forever. Diana was surprised by the request and explained that swearing was wicked. However, Anne clarified it meant making a solemn vow.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮急切地请戴安娜发誓永远做她的朋友。戴安娜对这个请求感到惊讶，解释说发誓是邪恶的行为。但安妮澄清说，这只是做一个庄重的承诺。

paragraphs.en: Relieved, Diana agreed and asked how to do it.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜松了口气，同意了，并询问该怎么做。

paragraphs.en: Anne and Diana stood together solemnly. "We must join hands—so," Anne said gravely. "Let’s imagine this path is running water.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和戴安娜并肩站立，神情庄重。“我们必须牵着手——就像这样。”安妮庄重地说，“让我们想象这条小径是流淌的溪水。

paragraphs.en: I’ll go first: I solemnly swear to be faithful to my bosom friend, Diana Barry, as long as the sun and moon shall endure." Diana laughed and repeated the oath, then declared, "You’re a queer girl, Anne. But I think I’m going to like you very much."
paragraphs.zh: 我先说：我庄重地发誓，要像太阳和月亮一样长久地忠于我的知心朋友戴安娜·巴里。“戴安娜笑起来，重复了誓言，然后说道：“安妮，你真是个奇怪的女孩。但我认为我会非常喜欢你的。”

paragraphs.en: At the log bridge, Marilla and Anne saw off Diana. The two girls walked arm-in-arm until they reached the brook, where they parted with promises to meet the next afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 在木桥边，玛丽拉和安妮送别了戴安娜。两个女孩挽着胳膊并肩走着，直到来到小溪旁，她们依依惜别，并约定第二天下午再相见。

paragraphs.en: "Did you find Diana a kindred spirit?" Marilla asked as they returned home through the garden of Green Gables.
paragraphs.zh: “你发现戴安娜是个志趣相投的人吗？”她们穿过绿山墙花园回到家时，玛丽拉问道。

paragraphs.en: "Oh yes," Anne sighed blissfully. "I’m the happiest girl on Prince Edward Island right now. I’ll say my prayers tonight with great enthusiasm.
paragraphs.zh: “当然了，”安妮幸福地叹了口气。“我现在是爱德华王子岛上最快乐的姑娘。今晚我一定会满怀热情地祈祷。”

paragraphs.en: Diana and I are going to build a playhouse in Mr. William Bell’s birch grove tomorrow. Can I have those broken pieces of china from the woodshed? Diana is lending me a book she says is splendid and exciting.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜和我要在威廉·贝尔先生的白桦林里建一个戏棚，明天就动工。能借我木柴堆里的那些破瓷片吗？戴安娜说她借给我一本书，非常精彩刺激。

paragraphs.en: She’s showing me rice lilies in the woods, and she has soulful eyes that I wish I had. We’re going to sing 'Nelly in the Hazel Dell' together. She’ll give me a beautiful picture of a lady in a pale blue silk dress from a sewing-machine agent.
paragraphs.zh: 她在树林里给我展示了水仙花，她那充满情感的眼睛让我羡慕。我们打算一起唱《NELLY在榛子坞》这首歌。她还会从缝纫机代理商那里给我一张穿着浅蓝色绸缎 dresses 的女士的美丽照片。

paragraphs.en: We plan to gather shells at the shore someday and call the spring by the log bridge the Dryad’s Bubble."
paragraphs.zh: 我们打算有一天去岸边捡贝壳，并把木桥旁的那眼泉叫做干adin的气泡。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla hoped Anne wouldn’t bore Diana with endless chatter. She reminded Anne that she couldn’t just play all day; work came first.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉希望安妮不要无休止地和戴安娜闲聊，让她分心。她提醒安妮，不能整天只玩耍，工作才是第一位的。

paragraphs.en: Matthew returned from a trip to Carmody with a small parcel for Anne. He sheepishly handed it over, glancing at Marilla apologetically.
paragraphs.zh: 马修从卡姆多回来，带着一个小包裹给安妮。他不好意思地递过去，歉意地瞥了玛丽拉一眼。

paragraphs.en: "I heard you like chocolate sweeties," he said, "so I got you some."
paragraphs.zh: “我听说你喜欢巧克力糖，”他说着，“所以给你买了一些。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla sniffed disapprovingly but softened. "They'll ruin her teeth and stomach," she said gently. "But since Matthew brought them, you can have a few.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉哼了一声，表示不满，但随即语气缓和下来：“这些糖会坏掉她的牙齿和胃。”她轻声说道，“不过既然马修带来了，你也可以拿几颗来吃。”

paragraphs.en: Peppermints are better for you."
paragraphs.zh: “薄荷糖对你的健康更有益。”

paragraphs.en: Anne eagerly agreed. "I won’t eat more than one tonight, Marilla. And I can give Diana half of them.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮迫不及待地答应了。“今晚我不会多吃一个的，玛丽拉。我可以把一半给戴安娜。”

paragraphs.en: It will taste twice as sweet to me if I share with her."
paragraphs.zh: 如果和她一起分享，这味道对我来说就会加倍甜蜜。

paragraphs.en: Marilla watched Anne go into her room. "She isn't stingy," she said. "It’s good she isn’t. I’m glad I agreed to keep her and that I’m getting fond of her, but don’t rub it in, Matthew Cuthbert."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉看着安妮进了房间。“她并不小气，”她说，“这一点很好。我很高兴答应收留她，并且开始喜欢上她了，不过马修·库伯特，你可别在这方面幸灾乐祸。”
